Azizur Rahman Chowdhury, Advocate, with M.A. Quader Chowdhury, Advocate ----- for the appellants. 
A.F.M. Shahid, Asst. Attorney General ----- for the State.
parties:
Abdul Bahar @ Abul Bahar & ors.
Vs.
The State
full_judgment: 5. In this case there are four alleged eye-witnesses to the occurrence. P.W. 1, the informant, has deposed that his father and his younger brother (P.W.2) went to plough the land after sun rise; his father purchased the land from Anisullah on payment of Tk. 500/- in advance; on hearing cries he came out of the house and saw the accused persons assaulting his father. He stated in his deposition that accused Sadek dealt a Jhata blow on the right side of the back of his father and accused Bahar dealt a Sulfi blow on the right side of the chest; accused Kaptan dealt a dao blow on the head and ear; his father then fell down head downwards; the accused persons then pressed him down and dealt several blows on his person with Jhata, Sulfi and Dao. He wanted to obstruct the assailant but failed; he raised alarm and hearing the cries P.W. Jamiruddin, Khotai and others came; the accused appellants then went away; they then took his father to their house from the P.O.; the accused persons again tried to attack them but failed because of intervention of the persons present; his father died soon after he was removed to the house. The witness further deposed that P.W.6 Iskandar, P.W.7 Afroz, Hira and others came to their house and he narrated the occurrence to them. After the death of his father he procured a boat and carried the dead-body to thana; they reached the thana at about 1-30 P.M. and lodged the F.I.R. He further deposed that Safi and Abdul Gani (charge-sheeted witnesses) and Hira Mia (who was named in the F.I.R. as witness) have been gained over. In cross-examination this witness deposed that his father had purchased the land of Anisullah which the latter used to possess specifically out of the ejmali land belonging, to the accused-appellant Sadek, Kaptan and Anisullah. This witness could not state the Khatian and plot No. of the land in which accused-appellant Bahar had damaged the paddy plants. He stated in cross-examination that his mother (P.W.2), P.W. 5, Jamiruddin, P.W.4 Khatoi and many others came to the P.O. He further stated in cross-examination that 15/20 persons came to the P.O. after him. He denied the suggestion of the defence that he had not stated in the F.I.R. that Sahanur P.W.3 went to the field with his father. The witness denied the suggestion of the defence that his father is a man of questionable character and used to commit dacoity and theft etc. and that the occurrence is a false one-P.W.2 the wife of the deceased has stated that on hearing cries of his son and husband she came out and rushed to the P.O. with her son P.W.1 She corroborated the deposition of P.W.1 as regards the assaulting of the deceased by the accused persons with various weapons namely Sulfi, Jhata and Dao. She also stated that her husband fell down on receipt of the injuries and thereafter he was given further blows with Sulfi, Jhata etc. by the accused persons; P.W.S. Jamiruddin, P.W.4, Khatoi, Abdul Gani and Sufi came to the P.O. when they were carrying her husband to their house and that her husband died soon after he was brought to the house; she further stated that she narrated the occurrence to Jamiruddin, Iskandar, Afroz. Mannaf and others, In cross-examination this witness stated that about 10 persons came to the P.O. on hearing alarm. She also stated in her cross-examination that her husband went to the P.O. alter sun rise alter taking tea and mud. P.W.3 is a son of the deceased. He stated that he went to plough the land along with his father and when his father had been ploughing the land lie put the ladder and rode upon it. This witness corroborated the evidence of P.W.1 as regards the assaults made by the accused persons upon his lather. He also stated that his lather fell down and thereafter all the accused persons dealt several blows. He raised alarm, and his brother, mother, Jamiruddin and others came to the P.O. In cross-examination he stated that he is aged about 10 years. He further stated that after Sadek dealt a blow on his father he ran away to some distance and stopped at the back of their house. He also found his mother and brother there; they took their lather from the P.O. to their house. P.W.4, Khatoi deposed that he saw that accused Sadek dealt a Jhata blow on the right side of the back of deceased Israil, Bahar dealt a Sulfi on the left side of the chest and accused. Kaptan dealt Dao blow on the head and ear of Israil. He further deposed that Israil fell down and then the accused went away; Iskandar, Afroz and many others came to the P.O. He further stated that on his arrival at the P.O. he saw P.Ws.1-3. He also joined others for carrying the injured to the house of the deceased and that they were obstructed by Sadek and Kaptan. He further stated in cross-examination that the deceased was his Mamato bhai. He stated further that he heard cries from his house and that Hira and Iskandar and others came to the P.O. after him and that on his way to the P.O. he did not come across anybody. He however in cross-examination stated that on arrival at the P.O. he saw 7/8 persons. He denied the suggestion of the defence that he did not specifically state to the I.O. as to who dealt blows upon the deceased and in which particular parts of the body, or that Iskandar, Hira, Afroz came at the P.O., or that he saw P.Ws.1 and 3 at the P.O. or that Sadek obstructed carrying the deceased to the house. He however, admitted in cross-examination that the deceased was a suspect in a dacoity case and was in hazat for some time. P.W.5, Jamiruddin deposed that he came to the place of occurrence upon hearing cries of P.Ws.1 and 2 and found them removing Israil on the northern ail of the P.O. He then joined others to carry the injured to the latter's house and that Israil died soon after. He stated in cross-examination that 4/5 persons arrived at the P.O. before him and 8/10 persons came to the P.O. after him and that out of them 4/5 persons were elders and disinterested. This witness was told about the occurrence in presence of elders. He swore an affidavit in this case and admitted his signature on the affidavit but he denied that he could read the writings on the affidavit. P.W.6, Iskandar was not examined by the Police and hence he was not a witness cited in the charge-sheet. He stated, P.W. 1-3 reported to him that Sadek, Bahar and Kaptan murdered Israil with Sulfi and Dao. He came to the house of the deceased and found him dead with injury. P.W.7, Afroz Mia was tendered for cross-examination. He stated in his cross-examination that he married the daughter of Bahar but his wife took divorce from hint five years back. P.W.8 the I.O. stated in cross-examination that P.W.2 did not specifically state who assaulted at which part of the body of the deceased or that the accused persons assaulted the deceased after he had fallen down. P.W.9 is the Doctor who examined the dead body of Israil.
